question: Does the static-YaRN fidelity penalty measured on ONE GPU at concurrency 1 (docs/46 s31) transfer to the production topology - DP8, eight GPUs, fp8 KV, MTP? Rope is per-layer arithmetic and should be topology-independent, but expectation is not measurement.
answer: YES, it replicates to within 3 %. DP8 measures 1.0265e-02 mean top-20 KLD against s31's 1.057e-02 on one GPU - a ratio of 0.971 - and the DP8 value falls INSIDE s31's 95 % CI of [8.42e-03, 1.29e-02]. Top-1 agreement 93.75 % against 93.23 %. The per-bucket shape also reproduces, including the counter-intuitive feature that the penalty is worst in the MIDDLE of the length range rather than at short lengths.

design.host: jl-vm-473501, 8x RTX PRO 6000, DP8, ForceP2P on
design.reference: 262k native rope - the production default this measurement then justified
design.candidate: 1,000,000-token window via Qwen official static YaRN factor 4.0
design.method: tools/yarn_penalty_analyze.py compare() reused verbatim so the shared-support rule matches s31 exactly

comparison_to_s31_one_gpu.verdict: An independent replication on different topology, different GPU count and a different concurrency regime, using the identical probe set and identical analysis code, agreeing to 3 %. This substantially strengthens s31 - it is no longer a single-machine result.

companion_result_concurrency.summary: Concurrency itself costs 1.278e-03, which is 1.08x the cross-boot floor and 8.4x SMALLER than the rope change. Serving under real load is indistinguishable from rebooting the same config, so no throughput or topology number in this project carries a hidden fidelity price.

decision_taken: The production endpoint was migrated to 262k native as part of this measurement, because the two results together settle it: the 1M WINDOW is fidelity-free (s31: 1.248e-03 against a 1.180e-03 floor) while the ROPE costs ~1.03e-02 on the 512-32k traffic our agents actually send. Serving YaRN by default taxed every real request to buy a window almost nothing used.
honest_limits: Both DP8 arms are quiet; the loaded condition was measured separately and is fidelity-neutral, so the two do not need combining.
384 positions, 48 prompts, four buckets, greedy, top-20 - same instrument and same ~1.2e-03 resolution as s31.
The DP8 262k arm is the reference here, so this measures the DIFFERENCE, not the absolute fidelity of either config against BF16.
One host. Topology-independence of rope is now measured on DP8 specifically, not proven in general.
